 Raiders roster 2026: Get to know Brett Rypien
 Veteran quarterback was signed to practice squad this week
 by Bill Williamson Nov 18, 2026, 6:04 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Las Vegas Raider recently signed quarterback Brett Rypien to the practice squad recently.
 Let’s take a closer look at Rypien:
 Size: 
 6-2, 212 pounds.
 NFL experience: 
 The Raiders are the 12 program (He was with the Minnesota Vikings twice) he has been part of since entering the NFL in 2019. He was with Denver from 2019-22. He last threw a pass in a regular-season game in 2023 while with the Los Angeles Rams. He was released from Tampa Bay’s practice squad last month.
 Draft status: 
 Rypien went undrafted in 2019.
 College: 
 He went to Boise State.
 Raiders ties: 
Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak was Denver’s passing game coordinator and quarterbacks coach in 2022 when Rypien played four games.
 Famous family: 
 His uncle is Mark Rypien a Super Bowl MVP quarterback.
 How he will fit in with Raiders: 
 Rypien is the third quarterback in the Raiders’ program behind starter Fernando Mendoza and backup Aidan O’Connell. Las Vegas needed to add to the quarterback room because they traded Kirk Cousins to the Minnesota Vikings last week. Rypien’s history with Kubiak made this an easy choice.
